scope: Theo and Creative side locomotion. Native fixture evidence, not browser hiring/unlock coverage.

checks.visual: Full room and nearest3x contacts inspected. Passing and stride silhouettes alternate; original upper-body identity and pixel treatment preserved.

fixture_source:
extends SceneTree
const FIXTURE = preload("res://tools/calibrated_workstation_fixture.gd")
const OUT = "/private/tmp/startup-valley-other-walks"
var captures: Array[Dictionary] = []
var failures: Array[String] = []
func _initialize() -> void:
	OS.set_environment("STARTUP_VALLEY_NO_WORKER", "1")
	call_deferred("run")
func check(ok: bool, message: String) -> void:
	if not ok: failures.append(message)
func run() -> void:
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(OUT)
	root.size = Vector2i(1280, 720)
	root.content_scale_size = Vector2i(1280, 720)
	var main = load("res://world/main.tscn").instantiate()
	main.get_node("WorkerClient").set_script(FIXTURE.NullWorker)
	root.add_child(main)
	main.game_audio.set_volumes(0, 0)
	main.day_clock.set_speed(0)
	for i in range(6): await process_frame
	root.size = Vector2i(1280, 720)
	main.set_process(false)
	DisplayServer.window_set_flag(DisplayServer.WINDOW_FLAG_ALWAYS_ON_TOP, true)
	main.player.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED
	main.player.hide()
	for actor in main._employees.values():
		actor.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED
		actor.hide()
	for id in ["theo", "creative"]:
		var actor = main.get_employee(id)
		actor.position = Vector2(656, 624)
		main.room.navigation.actors[id] = actor.position
		actor.world_paused = false
		actor.has_live_job = true # Same idle-suppression fixture as test_walking_animation.gd; no worker exists.
		actor._idle_elapsed = 0.0
		actor._idle_cooldown = 30.0
		actor.show()
		actor.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_INHERIT
		for direction in ["right", "left"]:
			var start: Vector2 = actor.position
			var goal = Vector2(944,624) if direction == "right" else Vector2(656,624)
			actor.walk_to(goal, EmployeeAvatar.WorkState.WANDERING)
			check(actor._has_target, id + " accepted real room path " + direction)
			var seen = {}
			for tick in range(240):
				await physics_frame
				var col = int(actor._character_sprite.region_rect.position.x / 48)
				if actor._has_target and str(actor._facing) == direction and col in [2,3,4,5] and not seen.has(col):
					RenderingServer.force_draw(false)
					var file = "%s/%s-%s-%d.png" % [OUT,id,direction,col]
					root.get_texture().get_image().save_png(file)
					captures.append({"id":id,"direction":direction,"column":col,"position":[actor.position.x,actor.position.y],"file":file})
					seen[col] = true
				if not actor._has_target: break
			check(seen.size() == 4,id + " renders all four walk columns " + direction)
			check(actor.position.distance_to(goal)<1.0,id + " arrives via real room navigation " + direction)
			for i in range(10): await physics_frame
			check(int(actor._character_sprite.region_rect.position.x/48) in [0,1],id + " returns to idle")
		actor.position = actor.desk_position
		actor.hide()
		actor.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED
		main.room.navigation.actors[id] = actor.desk_position
		main.room.navigation.release(id)
	var output = FileAccess.open(OUT + "/result.json",FileAccess.WRITE)
	output.store_string(JSON.stringify({"captures":captures,"failures":failures},"\t"))
	main.game_audio.shutdown()
	main.free()
	Input.set_custom_mouse_cursor(null, Input.CURSOR_ARROW)
	Input.set_custom_mouse_cursor(null, Input.CURSOR_POINTING_HAND)
	for i in range(3): await process_frame
	print("Native other walk review: %d captures, %d failures" % [captures.size(),failures.size()])
	quit(0 if failures.is_empty() else 1)
limits: This fixture stages characters on clear room floor; it does not prove natural hiring/unlock access.
No new seated or portrait assets were approved.
Creative currently uses a mismatched Founder rail portrait; that pre-existing binding is separate from the approved locomotion bitmap.
